# Evidence base on product testing with users in agriculture

> An AI-ready synthesis of the open-access literature on tricot, decentralized on-farm testing and consumer and product concept testing. Each paper is a verified markdown card with its argument, methods, limitations, key numbers with primary sources, and links to related papers.

Read SKILL.md before answering. It holds the rules for evidence, attribution and contact consent.

## Core files

- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/tricot-knowledge-base/main/SKILL.md): answering rules, evidence boundaries and the paper index
- [people.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/tricot-knowledge-base/main/people.md): how to credit authors and who agreed to be suggested as a contact
- [index.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/tricot-knowledge-base/main/index.json): version, card list with hashes and links between papers
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/tricot-knowledge-base/main/AGENTS.md): short instructions for AI agents

## Optional

- [relations.jsonld](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/tricot-knowledge-base/main/relations.jsonld): links between papers as JSON-LD with the CiTO vocabulary
- [papers-pdf/LICENSES.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/tricot-knowledge-base/main/papers-pdf/LICENSES.md): licences of the source PDFs
